literal.prompt: Какой напиток памятка CDC о здоровом питье (март 2026 года) рекомендует выбирать, чтобы сократить калории, поступающие с напитками?

literalGroups.primaryGround: CDC says replacing sugary drinks with plain water can help reduce caloric intake because water has no calories (L31), and explicitly advises choosing water over sugary drinks (L56). The revised stem asks for this attributed recommendation without naming the excluded sugar category. All four labels are comparable ordinary beverages without sweet/sugar cues. Regular soda is a plausible common drink; milk and 100% juice are plausible because CDC also describes nutrient-containing drinks and says to enjoy them within calorie limits (L70, L74); plain water is the unique directly stated substitution recommendation.

literalGroups.literal: CDC предлагает заменять сладкие напитки обычной водой: так можно уменьшить поступление калорий из напитков. Это общий совет памятки, а не утверждение, что другие напитки не участвуют в водном балансе.
literalGroups.primaryGround: CDC says replacing sugary drinks with plain water can help reduce caloric intake because water has no calories (L31). Other beverages also contribute to total water intake (L47); this is a substitution recommendation, not a claim that water is the only healthy beverage.

literalGroups.literal: CDC относит обычную сладкую газировку к напиткам, которые содержат калории, но мало питательных веществ.
literalGroups.primaryGround: CDC lists regular sodas under sugary drinks and states that this category contains calories but little nutritional value (L77). This is useful information about the ordinary soda option.

literalGroups.literal: Молоко содержит кальций, калий и витамин D.
literalGroups.primaryGround: CDC states that milk contains calcium, potassium and vitamin D (L74), a concrete fact about this plausible beverage alternative.

literalGroups.primaryGround: CDC says limited amounts of 100% fruit juice contain important nutrients and should be enjoyed within recommended calorie limits (L70); this directly informs the specific option.

literalGroups.literal: В обычной воде нет калорий. Она учитывается в общем ежедневном потреблении воды.
literalGroups.primaryGround: CDC says plain water has no calories (L31) and counts toward daily total water intake (L51). The latter fact is additional to the prompt/key.
